name: Remote-control communications-loss inhibit
aliases: substations Substation automation and command interfaces
summary: Applies the documented restraint to remote operating requests when their required communication path is lost.
description: Applies the documented restraint to remote operating requests when their required communication path is lost. Station automation collects measurements and statuses and issues assigned commands through defined authority paths. A communicated point has a value, quality and equipment identity; it should not be treated as an unexplained contact.

In a substation control building, the station controller receives bay information and forwards an operator's selected command to the correct bay device. Device feedback confirms whether the intended result actually occurred. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Link health and authority” at the input and “Remote-operation restraint” at the output. Local protection must retain its defined independence.
